post.topic: Automated WhatsApp patient recall for dental hygiene checkups
post.headline: Stop *Losing Patients* To Forgotten 6-Month Checkups
post.subline: Turn inactive patient files into confirmed hygiene bookings automatically using structured WhatsApp recall messages.
post.caption:
Most dental practices lose thousands every month to forgotten 6-month checkups.

Patients simply forget to schedule, and receptionists rarely have time to manually call hundreds of inactive files.

An automated WhatsApp recall system tracks patient treatment dates automatically. When a checkup is due, it sends a friendly personalized message with available open slots. Patients reply in seconds to confirm.

Quick tip: Audit your patient database today and segment everyone who hasn't visited in 7+ months for a targeted recall broadcast.

Save this post for later and send it to a clinic owner who needs full appointment books.

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call
post.insight_note: Targeting patient retention via hygiene recalls provides an immediate, high-ROI solution for dental practices without adding extra work for front-desk staff.
